Nora (NimbusCo): hey @Ana, hitting intermittent 401s from the new JS SDK during our CI runs. sometimes we also get bursts of 429s. started after switching to serverless warmup job.
Ana (CSM): thanks — can you paste the minimal repro logs and SDK version? staging or prod env? looping in @Devin (SDK) and @Ravi (SRE). :eyes:
Nora (NimbusCo): SDK v2.1.0, staging. quick log: 
```
POST /v1/generate 401 {\n  id: "req_6abf...",\n  error: "unauthorized",\n  hint: "missing auth header"\n}\n// but curl with same token returns 200 from dev box
// pattern: CI runs 50 parallel warmup jobs -> ~20% 401 + occasional 429s
```
Nora (NimbusCo): headers from CI runner show Authorization present: `Authorization: Bearer ***` — so odd that server says missing.
Devin (SDK): quick thought — some proxies (esp serverless warmup or API gateways) strip `Authorization` on certain preflight/redirect flows. can you check if there's an edge proxy or function URL that re-issues requests? also, which SDK instantiation are you using? sample config helps.
Nora (NimbusCo): we use GH Actions with a small edge-side lambda that fans out requests. lambda uses `fetch()` to call Redwood.
Ravi (SRE): CI runners sometimes have clock drift which breaks short-lived JWTs. also parallel fanout can trigger our burst window -> 429. two separate issues could look similar. check `iat`/`exp` on the token.
Nora (NimbusCo): token sample (sanitized): `{"iat":1689390000,"exp":1689390060}` — TTL 60s. our job spins up 50 runners at once.
Ana (CSM): TTL 60s is tight for parallel warmups. we recommend >=5min for ephemeral tokens in fanout cases, or a token refresh flow per runner. i'll ask ops to temporarily raise onboarding throttle. :+1:
Devin (SDK): SDK workaround: enable header fallback and client-side jitter. in v2.1.0 there's an undocumented `forceAuthHeader` flag that ensures we send credentials in query fallback if header missing. try: 
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, forceAuthHeader: true, maxConcurrency: 5 })
```
Devin (SDK): also add a tiny splay when booting workers, e.g., random 0..200ms before init. reduces stampede. i can open a quick patch to default the splay in our examples.
Ravi (SRE): on our side i see request traces where `x-edge-proxy: lambda-proxy` and an empty `authorization` header on the edge -> looks like the lambda runtime removed it when calling outbound. suggestion: set the token on the lambda environment and pass directly in the function call (avoid relying on inbound header forward).
Nora (NimbusCo): ok — we have a header-forwarding middleware that only forwards a whitelist. looks like `Authorization` wasn't whitelisted for internal fanout requests. i'll change that and rerun.
Ana (CSM): action items: 1) Nora whitelist Authorization on internal fanout (Nora) 2) Nora increase token TTL or implement per-run refresh (Nora) 3) Devin add example snippet + recommend splay in docs (Devin) 4) Ana request temporary onboarding quota bump (Ana) 5) Ravi monitor traces & confirm no backend auth regression (Ravi). i'll mark this thread and follow up tomorrow. :memo:
DeployBot: Ops request created: OPS-4127 (onboarding quota bump) — assignee: infra-ops.
Nora (NimbusCo): quick update — whitelisted header and added 100-300ms jitter. re-ran CI: no 401s in 3 runs, 429s dropped from ~12% to ~1%. thanks all. :tada:
Ana (CSM): love it — i'll keep OPS-4127 open until we confirm steady state. Devin, can you follow up with a tiny README change?
Devin (SDK): will do, pushing docs PR with example and recommended retry wrapper. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/218 (will post when ready).
Ravi (SRE): leaving a trace note: if you must keep short TTLs, implement token exchange (one long-lived per runner -> short-lived per request) to avoid issues.
Nora (NimbusCo): noted. thanks everyone — closing for now, will reopen if it resurfaces. :wave:
